title: S.I. No. 14 of 2026 - Value Added Tax Act (Alteration of Rate of Penalty)
text:
103
Value Added Tax Act - Resolution of Parliament to approve the draft
Value Added Tax (Alteration of Rate of Penalty) Order
SAINT LUCIA
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT, 2026, No. 14
[ 16th February, 2026 ]
RESOLUTION
WHEREAS it is provided under section 46(4) of the Value Added
Tax Act, Cap. 15.42 (the Act) that any person who fails to pay tax
being the whole or part of the remainder of any tax due or payable
under the Act by the due date is liable to a penalty equal to ten per
cent of the amount of tax due;
AND WHEREAS it is provided under section 46(4A) of the Act
that the Minister responsible for finance may, by Order published in
the Gazette, alter the rate of penalty under the Act;
AND WHEREAS it is further provided under section 46(4A) of
the Act that an Order made pursuant to section 46(4A) of the Act is
subject to an affirmative resolution of Parliament;
AND WHEREAS the Minister of Finance seeks approval of the
draft Value Added Tax (Alteration of Rate of Penalty) Order by an
affirmative resolution of Parliament to alter, from the 2nd day of May,
2024 to the 1st day of May, 2026, the rate of penalty from ten per cent
to zero per cent on the whole or part of the remainder of tax due or
payable under the Act for the tax periods before and ending on the
31st day of December, 2023;

104
Value Added Tax Act - Resolution of Parliament to approve the draft
Value Added Tax (Alteration of Rate of Penalty) Order
BE IT RESOLVED that Parliament by affirmative resolution
approves the draft Value Added Tax (Alteration of Rate of Penalty)
Order which alters, from the 2nd day of May, 2024 to the 1st day of
May, 2026, the rate of penalty from ten per cent to zero per cent on the
whole or part of the remainder of tax due or payable under the Act for
the tax periods before and ending on the 31st day of December, 2023.
Passed in the House of Assembly this 3rd day of February, 2026.
CLAUDIUS J. FRANCIS,
Speaker of the House of Assembly.
Passed in the Senate this 10th day of February, 2026.
ALVINA REYNOLDS,
President of the Senate.
SAINT LUCIA
